rationale: Setup always limits at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC; hold (+0.08-0.11 ns), slew/cap (<=18 vs bar 89) and router DRC (all 0) have ample room, so spend effort on setup. Loose targets (9.3-9.8 ns) left IO-port paths critical and T_eff >=5.9; the best runs aimed near 5.0 ns and still ended with +0.2-0.3 ns slack (md5 4.669, bm64 4.808), so aim at 4.70 ns, just above the best T_eff, to push repair harder. Every tight-target success used timing-driven placement; des (none, DELAY 4, no sizing/buffering) collapsed to 7.78. Both top runs used SYNTH_SIZING; md5 added AREA 3, ABC buffering, cap213 and post-GRT timing repair. Floorplan, density, margins and repair % stay free.
